items.title: Tabular Orchestration for SAP-RPT, hands-on: from zero to a governed context in HDLFS
items.author: Antonio_leites
items.text: A hands-on walkthrough of SAP Tabular Orchestration: from deploying the service and registering a context in HANA Cloud data lake Files to the first prediction, including the behaviour not yet in the documentation. Moving the reference context out of the client preserved 519 of 520 SAP-RPT-1.5 predictions, and a comparison with SAP-RPT-1.6 and TabPFN-3.5-Plus shows where the model version matters.

items.title: COGS Splitting and Consumption Revaluation in CKMLCP: Why CKM3 and ACDOCA May Differ
items.author: mnabood
items.text: The way consumption revaluation behaves in CKMLCP depends heavily on the COGS Splitting configuration. A single configuration setting can change how the same revaluation amount is distributed across COGS accounts. This article explains how Movement Type Groups, COGS Splitting, and the “Split Revalued Consumption with Actual Cost Component Split” setting influence the final postings and why the results seen in CKM3 and ACDOCA may not appear identical.

outline: Review the RAP managed runtime phases: modify, determinations, validations, then save
Set external breakpoints in ADT for handler methods
Trace the sequence of determinations and validations
Find common causes of failed saves
Read the dump and log output in ADT
class_idea.exercise: Take a managed RAP BO with one validation and one determination. Set breakpoints in both handler methods. Create an instance through the preview app or an EML test class. Step through the code and record how `reported` and `failed` are filled when the validation fails.
